purpose: Portraits for the hero presets in public/hero-looks.js. Until a file exists the look is drawn as a vector placeholder. To switch a look to its illustration, save it in public/assets/heroes/ and set that look's `image` to the file name.
format: Square 512x512 WebP, head and shoulders, centred, neutral light background (the game tints a circle behind it), no text. Soft illustrated style matching the other character portraits. The face is calm and friendly; same framing for all ten so they sit well in a row of small circles.
